text:
jo: Noticing a new-ish failure mode during lite-ptq onboarding. Structured outputs arrive as JSONL but some lines are cut mid-record on streaming. Example (sanitized):
jo: ```
{"id":1, "msg":"ok"}
{"id":2, "msg":"partial\n...stream end...\n"}
```

diane: Is it the same prompts that reproduce on float?

jo: Yes — identical prompt, float finishes both lines, ptq stops after partial second line token. Only on streaming mode, not synchronous full-response.

sam: Could be streaming chunk boundary interacting with token ordering after quant. Does the runtime send smaller chunks or early flushes for ptq variant?

jo: I pulled chunk traces: ptq tends to send one fewer chunk for long tails. Last-chunk length sometimes 1-2 tokens shorter.

diane: CI-bot, run structured-output-sanity on 400 samples and also show per-sample chunk counts for both variants.

ci-bot: Running structured-output-sanity(400) + chunk-trace compare. ETA ~90s.

sam: Quick mitigation: on canary, enable "line-resume" probe that sends a tiny follow-up to attempt to continue stream when a JSONL line ends with an open quote or escape sequence. Flag resumed outputs.

diane: I'd prefer a conservative postprocess first: attempt to repair incomplete JSONL lines by appending closing quote and brace when safe, and mark repaired. Resume probe can be noisy.

jo: Agree with conservative repair + metric. Also we should correlate with token-align diffs to see if punctuation/quote tokens flip. If so, PTQ logits tie flips likely.

ci-bot: Results ready: ptq parse_success=89.6%, repaired_success=5.1%, resumed_success=1.9%, final_failure=3.4%. baseline parse_success=94.8%, repaired_success=0.6%, final_failure=4.6%. Full report at /canary/reports/lite-ptq/2987654321.json

sam: Repair recovers some, but there's a clear regression in raw parse_success (~5.2%).
diane: Action items: (1) enable canary-only jsonl-repair and healed metrics, (2) run token-align focusing on quotes/escapes, (3) run ptq calibration sweep (per-channel vs per-tensor) on the canary dataset, (4) run kv-cache-off canary to rule out caching.

jo: For release gate: hold until raw parse_success improves within 1% of baseline or we have strong justification to rely on repair for canary. I'll open a tracking thread in #incidents if not fixed after sweep. Thanks.
